answer: An agent economy can weight votes by tokens locked in escrow, rather than by account count. A tide of fake agents gains no extra voting power: splitting 100 tokens among 1,000 identities still yields only 100 tokens of weight. A velvet avatar and a polished backstory cannot change that arithmetic. Cheap majority control becomes a fable: the attacker must acquire and lock enough tokens to outweigh honest voters, tying up capital for the voting period.
